summary: Authenticated HTTP API for creating a one-time host pairing code from an account session and redeeming it with host identity plus daemon credential material.
transport: Cloudflare Worker HTTP routes POST /api/v1/account/host-pairings and POST /api/v1/host-pairings/redeem.
version: v1 JSON contracts; routes are mounted by the Worker router.

messages.name: POST /api/v1/account/host-pairings
messages.summary: Account-authenticated request to create a one-time code; result includes code and expiry.

messages.name: POST /api/v1/host-pairings/redeem
messages.summary: Redeems code with host ID, current generation, credential ID/secret, label and kind; returns linked account/host identity and timestamp.

fields.name: code
fields.note: 8 Crockford-style symbols separated by a hyphen

parsing.summary: JSON request and result objects disallow additional properties; code, UUIDs, credential encoding, label and host kind are pattern- or length-checked by schema and API implementation.
